titulo: Green party leader Zack Polanski to stand in byelection for Keir Starmer seat
cuerpo: Polanski says he will ‘stand up for people struggling to pay their bills’ if he becomes MP for Holborn and St Pancras UK politics live – latest updates Zack Polanski will stand as a candidate in the Holborn and St Pancras byelection, he has announced. The leader of the Green party in England and Wales told the Camden New Journal on Thursday he would “stand up for people struggling to pay their bills” if he is elected as the representative for the area, which became vacant when Keir Starmer announced he was standing down as an MP .
